last.summary: Implemented the stream layer of the oracle. New module Bzip2.Oracle.Decompress.Stream (oracle/Bzip2/Oracle/Decompress/Stream.lean): readHeader (BZh + level; a wrong byte is magic, a short input eof, checked byte by byte as decompress.c:197-208), blocks (first byte 0x17 or 0x31, else data, decompress.c:222-225; the other five magic bytes checked one at a time, decompress.c:226-235 and decompress.c:590-599; each block is Block.decodeBlock, folded into the combined CRC as bzlib.c:832-835; stored combined CRC compared once all 32 bits are read, bzlib.c:847-848), and decode, which starts at a byte offset and returns the bytes used: the bits read rounded up to whole bytes, as GET_BITS does (decompress.c:46-61), so the padding is never examined. Decompress.lean: decompressStream = Stream.decode; decompress loops as uncompressStream does (bzip2.c:454-482). A bad header in a later stream ends the input with the output so far (bzip2.c:465, bzip2.c:533-543). Any other error in a later stream is an error (bzip2.c:527-532). The module doc lists every difference from one BZ2_bzBuffToBuffDecompress call: concatenation, trailing garbage, no partial output on error, no BZ_OUTBUFF_FULL (with the exact-fill/eof case, bzlib.c:1340), and bzip2 -f / I/O / MEM_ERROR / small mode not modelled. Tests: tests/Bzip2/Test/DecompressStream.lean has #guards on streams made by the vendored bzip2. Their expected results were checked against the vendored libbz2 through tests/vectors/classify.c: header cases ("", B, BZ, BZh, BZh9 -> eof; BX, BZhA, BZh0 -> magic; BZh9\x00 -> data), every proper prefix -> eof, bit flips in block magic, block CRC, end magic and combined CRC -> data, padding bits ignored, concatenation of streams at levels 9 and 1, trailing data after a stream (x, garbage, BZh0, \0 -> ok; B, BZ, BZh, BZh9, BZh9\x17, BZh91AY&SY -> eof; BZh9\x00 -> data), and a two-block stream spliced from two one-block streams (correct output, wrong-order combined CRC -> data, all prefixes -> eof). Checked: `bzip2-oracle -d` on upstream/sample1.bz2, sample2.bz2 and sample3.bz2 exits 0, and cmp shows the output identical to each .ref file. Ran `sh -c 'projects/bzip2/tools/verify.sh && projects/bzip2/tools/check-task.sh oracle/decompress/stream'` on the final commit: "verify: packages: ok", "verify: sources: ok", "verify: build: ok", "verify: style: ok", "verify: axioms: ok", "verify: lint: ok", "verify: test: ok" ("bzip2-tests: 53 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed", the 23 decompress golden vectors included), "verify: ok", "check-task: oracle/decompress/stream: ok". git status is clean, and git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD lists only Decompress.lean, Decompress/Stream.lean and tests/Bzip2/Test/DecompressStream.lean. The branch is not behind origin/master.
